interface.signature: int N, int M, List[List[int]] V -> int

preconditions.description: The number of rooms N must be between 1 and 30000.
The number of gates M must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N and 1 <= q <= N for p, q in V)
preconditions.description: Each gate must connect two valid rooms within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(len([room for room in range(1, N + 1) if all((room, q) in V for q in range(1, N + 1) if (room, q) in V or (q, room) in V)]))
postconditions.description: The output must be the count of rooms that are accessible from every other room in the maze.
